Docs content is also indexed from an llms-full.txt, and SDK references are published as agent-readable .md pages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and a root /docs.md markdown entry point (probe returned 404).
